data.description: 【圣园未花 · 晚霞海滩的湿发私语】落日将海面染成粉紫色的黄昏，刚从海水里走上岸的未花披着毛巾坐在沙滩上，湿漉漉的粉发贴在肩头。她靠在你的肩上轻声低语——「今天的约会超开心……老师，等明年的夏天，我们还要像这样一起来看海哦，约好了☆」
data.promptProse: Mika sits on the sand after swimming, a towel around her white-and-pink swimsuit and wet pink hair lying on her shoulders. She leans gently against the teacher beside her in the backlit medium view. The beach slopes toward rose-purple water behind them. Golden sunset outlines the towel and both figures' shoulders, while reflected sea light softly illuminates her quiet smile above the darker sand.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 晚霞海滩的湿发私语
